question: Do the non-compete period and the employee non-solicitation period last the same length of time?
ground_truth_answer: No. The non-compete restriction lasts eighteen (18) months after termination, while the non-solicitation of employees restriction lasts twenty-four (24) months — two different durations.

expected_citations.span_hint: Employee shall not solicit Company's employees to leave their employment for twenty-four (24) months following termination.
